description: This is a Java test class for the AnySoftKeyboard project, specifically testing inline suggestions functionality within the keyboard input method. It uses Mockito and Robolectric for unit testing Android UI components related to inline suggestions, including response handling, UI updates, and user interactions.

classes.name: AnySoftKeyboardInlineSuggestionsTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for testing inline suggestions behavior in the AnySoftKeyboard input method, including UI updates, response handling, and user interactions.

methods.name: mockResponse
methods.description: Creates a mocked InlineSuggestionsResponse with specified views and optional hints, simulating inline suggestions responses.

methods.name: testActionStripNotAddedIfEmptySuggestions
methods.description: Verifies that no action strip UI is added when the inline suggestions response is empty.

methods.name: testActionStripAdded
methods.description: Checks that the action strip UI is added correctly when a suggestion response with views is received.

methods.name: testActionStripAddedForGeneric
methods.description: Verifies that the correct icon is used for generic suggestions.

methods.name: testActionStripAddedForUnknown
methods.description: Verifies that the default icon is used for suggestions with unknown hints.

methods.name: testActionStripAddedForAi
methods.description: Checks that the AI-specific icon is used when suggestions indicate AI features.

methods.name: testActionStripAddedForSmartReply
methods.description: Verifies that the smart reply icon is used for suggestions indicating smart replies.

methods.name: testCreatesCorrectRequest
methods.description: Ensures that the inline suggestions request created by the input method is correctly formed.

methods.name: testShowsSuggestionsOnClickAction
methods.description: Tests that clicking the action strip displays the inline suggestions list and updates the UI accordingly.

methods.name: testPrioritizePinnedSuggestions
methods.description: Verifies that pinned suggestions are prioritized and appear at the top of the suggestions list.

methods.name: testClosesInlineSuggestionsOnPick
methods.description: Ensures that inline suggestions are dismissed when a suggestion is selected.
